title: Thermodynamic Channel Capacity, Gordon-Holevo Thermal Ceilings, and Intracellular Signaling Horizons of 71-THz Mito-Polariton Channels
abstract: Completing our six-paper machine-checked audit series (P1-P6) following ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2, ARR-2026-1E91AXEJYT890TQC, and ARR-2026-1F61YM5EHC95TBMP on the unrefereed 71-THz mito-polariton preprint bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1 (awaiting independent replication), we establish exact bosonic thermal-loss channel capacity ceilings and intracellular signaling horizons backed by MITO-POLARITON-CHANNEL-CAPACITY-CERT-1.0 (20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 Classical.choice; AST-audited zero-float verifier; 16 SHA-256 certificates C01-C16; 58 adversarial tests). We prove: (i) exact rational dyadic-Mercator brackets on the Giovannetti-Holevo capacity C_Hol and pure-loss subadditivity (C01-C08); (ii) the 3-dB PLOB antidegradability wall forcing quantum capacity Q = 0 identically for eta <= 1/2 (C03-C04); (iii) an exact beta*h*nu in (10.99, 11.00)x energy-per-bit penalty for incoherent heterodyne reception (32.609/eta zJ) over coherent Landauer-Holevo decoding (2.966/eta zJ) at 71 THz, 310 K (C05-C06); (iv) exact signaling horizons at 0.1 pW (1% basal mito power): 1 kbit/s permitted up to 8.03 L_att (24.1 um, C09) or 10.43 L_att (31.3 um Holevo, C10), 10 Mbit/s forbidden for heterodyne even at eta=1 (C13), and 1 Gbit/s unconditionally forbidden even for Holevo (C15) and even at 100% mito power (10 pW) under heterodyne (C16); and (v) a unified six-paper P1-P6 synthesis matrix.
